story.title: ACTIONS SPEAK LOUDER THAN WORDS
paragraphs_en: Everyone was praising her brother and not her.

Her father jumped with joy when he heard her brother came first in class. Her mother gave him sweets when she heard that he would receive a prize on the stage on Republic Day. Her grandfather twisted his moustache proudly when he heard he ran faster than the others and her grandmother was happy when she learnt that he shared his songs with others.
Chinnu was feeling miserable because no one praised her or gave her any sweets to eat.
Chinnu got an idea - she decided to tell every one that she was also doing something, just like her brother.
She told her parents, 'Tomorrow for the Republic Day function I am going to sing a song that I wrote on the stage.'
Everyone praised her and said that they will attend the function.

Chinnu thought that no one usually attended flag hoisting function and so she lied about her singing. Now what will she do? She wrote a song in the book only as a hobby. She has never performed on stage. Moreover, she has not given her name for the function. She felt tensed that others will soon find out her lies.
She couldn't sleep the whole night and got up in the morning fearing of what might happen.

In the school, she saw the teachers praising her brother for achieving many medals. She realized that her brother was not speaking lies like her. After flag hoisting, when every one was performing on stage, Chinnu was sweating with fear.

When they reached home, she was sure her parents would scold her for not singing. But she was surprised with their behavior: 'There wasn't sufficient time for the function' said her father. 'She was dull from morning, maybe she has sore throat,' said her mother. 'She will surely get another opportunity and she will practice nicely and sing,' said her grandfather. Chinnu understood that they all came to know about her lies and she felt ashamed.
Chinnu learnt a lesson. She decided only to speak about things that she could do. She realized that anyone would praise good actions. She began practicing for the next year's event.

sentences.text_en: She realized that anyone would praise good actions.
sentences.text_vi: Cô bé nhận ra rằng bất cứ ai cũng sẽ khen ngợi những hành động tốt.

sentences.text_en: She began practicing for the next year's event.
sentences.text_vi: Cô bé bắt đầu luyện tập cho sự kiện năm sau.
